expected.name: arena_evaluate
expected.description: Score a complete theorem (statement + proof) on the primary toolchain. Give `proof`, or an existing node with `candidate` ("#N"), or a probe with `from_probe` ("pN"). If it compiles, the harness checks the other toolchains in the background and reports the outcome in a later tool result; you never need to request it. `parents`, `idea_id`, `idea` (a one-line route title that creates the idea) and `hypothesis` are optional labels; the current candidate is the default parent. If `proof` comes with `candidate`, the proof is scored and that candidate becomes its parent. Returns tokens, heartbeats, per-axis contribution, estimated proxy, deltas, and diagnostics whose file_line matches the candidate file lean_goal reads.

proof.description: Complete theorem statement and replacement proof

idea.description: One-line route title; creates the idea and links this attempt to it

expected.name: arena_probe
expected.description: Compile one proof draft or one to four drafts on the primary toolchain. Each may be a complete theorem, a `by` proof body, or a `:=` proof body; the exact benchmark statement is supplied for proof bodies. `sorry` is allowed and each incomplete draft returns its actual hole goals and stable pN ID. Routes are fingerprinted from complete proofs that compile; drafts with `sorry` holes are not fingerprinted. A probe takes several drafts at once (two or three is typical). A complete compiling draft is automatically promoted to a candidate. `idea` (a one-line route title) creates an idea and links the attempt to it.

idea.description: One-line route title; creates the idea and links this attempt to it

expected.name: arena_profile
expected.description: Per-tactic heartbeat profile of a compiling proof: heartbeats per proof line or tactic block (inclusive and self), share of the total, nesting, the top self costs with cumulative share, and how the profiled total relates to the measured whole-proof heartbeats. Give `candidate` ("#N" or probe "pN"), `proof`, or nothing for the current candidate. Informational only; it makes no recommendation.

expected.name: arena_idea
expected.description: Create an idea (title, hypothesis, region such as proof lines "12-30", expected_effect per axis), optionally naming it yourself with idea_id; or update an existing idea by idea_id: set status active, parked, succeeded or abandoned with a reason. Ideas are yours; the harness only records them. Declaring a new idea closes the one that was current from the harness's own outcomes (succeeded if it produced the best candidate so far, abandoned if it made attempts without doing so, parked if it had none) and records that reason, so a separate status call is only needed to override it. The reply is a one-line acknowledgement.

expected.name: arena_state
expected.description: Show the best verified candidate, pinned original baseline, leading unchecked result, active idea with attempt count, and recent failures. Read-only and concise; no title or hypothesis is needed.

expected.name: arena_candidate
expected.description: Restore node "#N" or probe "pN" into the Lean scratch project (so lean_goal reads it) and return its exact proof and recorded results.

expected.name: arena_skill_read
expected.description: Read a file from the Arena Lean skill (for example references/proof-golfing.md). Without `path`, list the available files. Read-only and scoped to the skill directory.

expected.name: arena_source
expected.description: Read pinned source by a decl:<qualified-name> handle or a project/dependency path alias (up to 400 lines per call; next_first continues; a decl: handle without first starts at its declaration). Reports the pin, canonical path and file length.

expected.name: arena_declarations
expected.description: Read several declarations by qualified name or decl: handle. Returns full pinned source bodies, typed unavailable reasons, local scope/type, or per-name misses. Use next_cursor to continue a long batch.

expected.name: arena_find
expected.description: Search pinned source by several names or text queries. Results are distinct qualified declarations with name, decl: handle, path, line and signature (not the body; read bodies with arena_declarations), counted toward limit; at most 30 files are scanned per query and files_truncated reports more. Misses include qualified-name suggestions.

expected.name: arena_finish
expected.description: Request to stop the run. A confirm is accepted once 10% or less of the spend allowance remains. Before that, the call is refused with the amount spent and left, the routes tried and the current best's saving per score axis (compat, tokens, heartbeats). With 10% or less left, the first call returns one factual review (with at most one reminder if the current idea has no proof attempt) and a second call after the decision turn confirms the stop; finishing is final for this run.
